text.tspan: *need to make sure this check is made if array or shape is changed
Checks inputted array matches desired data type
Checks inputed array size matches desired shape
Check inputted value matches desired data type
Check dtype is a ValueType or ArrayType
Port is always associated with a node.
Port has identifier for which ImageOperation input it is associated with.
Port input is an Image or a Parameter.
Port output is an image array or variable
If port is for an image variable (this will also be checked by the Connection, but redundancy here):
Check Image.array_dtype matches that required by ImageOperation
Check Image.shape matches that required by ImageOperation
Output image.array.numpy() to associated ImageOperation input
If port is for a parameter:
Check parameter.dtype matches that required by ImageOperation
Output parameter.value.numpy() to associated ImageOperation input
